meta.name: c-level-skills
meta.description: Index and router for the C-level advisory bundle: 33 skills covering 14 C-suite roles, orchestration, cross-cutting capabilities, and culture. Use when exploring what the c-level-advisor bundle contains, deciding which advisor skill fits a question, or finding the entry points (cs-onboard interview, chief-of-staff routing, board-meeting protocol).

copy.tagline: 浏览和路由高管顾问技能包
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从一套高管顾问技能中快速找到合适的入口。
copy.tagline_en: Browse and route the C-level advisory skill bundle
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly find the right entry point among a set of C-level advisory skills.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会变成一个 C 级顾问技能包的索引和路由器。它不会直接提供建议，而是告诉你有哪些技能可用，并帮你找到最适合当前问题的顾问技能或入口（如创始人访谈、参谋长路由、董事会会议协议）。
howto.when: 当你探索 C 级顾问技能包的内容、决定哪个顾问技能适合某个问题，或需要找到入口（如创始人访谈、参谋长路由、董事会会议协议）时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看这个战略问题该找哪个顾问？
say.note: Claude 会使用参谋长技能路由到合适的顾问。

say.text: 我需要召开董事会会议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes an index and router for the C-level advisory bundle. It does not give advice directly but tells you what skills exist and helps you find the right advisor skill or entry point (e.g., founder interview, chief-of-staff routing, board-meeting protocol).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you explore the bundle contents, decide which advisor skill fits a question, or need to find entry points such as the founder interview, chief-of-staff routing, or board-meeting protocol.

say_en.text: Help me find which advisor fits this strategic question.
say_en.note: Claude routes to the right advisor using the chief-of-staff skill.
Claude runs the cs-onboard skill for a 7-dimension interview.

say_en.text: I need to hold a board meeting.
say_en.note: Claude invokes the board-meeting skill for a 6-phase deliberation.
